title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #4 OPERATION LEAD SEAL OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #4 OPERATION LEAD SEAL OPEN

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different “Contracts” to clear the stage. Complete certain strategies, improve level evaluation, and collect “Contract Bounty” and “Operation Agreement”.
“Contract Bounty” can be used to redeem rewards in “Secret Sanctuary”.
“Operation Agreement” can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
Coral Coast Collection – SUM019.ver for Castle-3
Season #4 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
You need to complete certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some Contracts.
The number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency level.

Compared with Season #3, Season #4 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site, and the Permanent Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The site’s rotation time and the challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
Several new Contracts will be added to the Season’s Permanent Site on July 20, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7).
After Season #4 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
After Season #4 ends, the Operation Agreement you collected will be automatically converted into Operation Lead Seal Supplies, the ratio is 1:1.
During Season #4, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
During Season #4, players can obtain Season #4 Medal set by achieving related goals.
DETAILS: During the event, the Exclusive Headhunting, "Earthborn Metals", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
Limited Operator Nian can ONLY be obtained from “Earthborn Metals” and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
0011 Series - Honor and Splendor for Swire
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
